overview: Like any young man, Louis is about to experience great changes. He is married to an unknown cousin and is to inherit the throne of Spain. In the middle of the 18th century, this would be a happy episode in the life of any prince, but things are not going to be easy for Louis. With a rebellious wife, an alienated father and a conspiring stepmother, Louis I has to begin his reign. Luckily for him, the problems will soon end.
title: La vida breve

overview: A handful of businessmen control Russian industry and especially the lucrative oil and gas sector, vital to the country's post-soviet economy and war effort in Ukraine. This series tells the story of this fabulously wealthy group of men who have shaped their country but only survive if they remain in Vladimir Putin's favour…
title: Oligarques, le gang de Poutine

overview: Gymkhana Grid profiles tells powerful emotional stories from a diverse range of drivers and what it takes to compete at the highest level.
title: Road to Gymkhana Grid Profiles

overview: Excited to make a fresh start away from London, Martyn and Rebecca move into a beautiful house in Glasgow with their two young children. At first the new home seems idyllic, but when their neighbour Jan makes unnerving comments to Rebecca it turns out to be the start of something far more intimidating. Facing accusations that are every parent's worst nightmare, and with the authorities refusing to step in, Martyn and Rebecca feel they have nowhere to turn to for help.
title: Fear

overview: Harlem Ice is a five-part documentary series following the coaches and girls of Figure Skating in Harlem as they prepare for competitions, performances, and a life-changing global experience. Through their eyes, we experience the highs and lows of the Figure Skating in Harlem organization's season and the unique experiences they have as girls of color breaking the "ice ceiling" and gaining access to a global stage.
title: Harlem Ice

overview: Marga and Martín happen to meet on a dating app, unaware they are neighbors. Although they have an instant connection, they decide not to pursue their romance following the unsaid rule: "one should never date one's neighbor." However, over time, these two will find it hard to hide their feelings behind the wall that keeps them apart.
title: Entre Paredes

overview: Vadhir and José Eduardo Derbez open a pop-up bar together, but opening a business for the first time is anything but easy! With the pressure of trying to make it a success, the brothers work hard but not without crazy and unexpected issues!
title: Par de Ideotas

overview: This series follows television & film phenomenon Pamela Anderson as she takes on her latest passion - cooking. Join Pamela as she invites some of today's most sought-after and buzz-worthy chefs to join her on a beautiful rural property on Vancouver Island, where together they'll prepare delicious plant-based meals for Pamela to enjoy with her family and friends.
title: Pamela's Cooking with Love

overview: The new Canadian-original documentary series Sounds Black (4×60) from Corus Entertainment examines the origins and impact of Black Music in Canada. Directed by award-winning filmmaker Cazhhmere Downey, with contributions from Canadian music luminaries, the four episodes take viewers on a journey through Black Canadian music's tangled diasporic roots and its road to international dominance.
title: Sounds Black

overview: A comedy series about what happens when a group of Africans unexpectedly arrives in a remote Russian village, and on the initiative of a local girl who has returned from Africa. The village head, Anatoly Stolbov, who is used to spending budgets and avoiding change, finds himself in a difficult situation: in order to retain power, he will have to help the Africans integrate. But his plan falls apart when he learns that his daughter is going to marry one of them.
title: Афродеревня

overview: Studio producer "WeiT Media". Originally filmed for the Russian TV channel "ДТВ" in 2010, but was not shown on air. When traditional investigation methods reach a dead end, professionals can look for any, at first glance, fantastic clues and even turn to psychics for help. To believe or not to believe them? This question arises in each episode, during the investigation of each dramatic case - until non-standard methods help to unravel the most complex crime. Each episode of the series "Psychics - Detectives" is the story of one difficult criminal offense, which is investigated in parallel by an investigator and a psychic. Psychics do not immediately see the full picture of what happened, but they provide the investigation with information obtained through visions, contact with the personal belongings of the victim, working with photographs. Receiving additional and much-needed information, the investigator can expand the circle of suspects, find additional evidence and solve the crime.
title: Экстрасенсы-детективы

overview: Our country is a huge market for paid magic services. Neither marriages nor business deals are concluded without consulting an astrologer or psychic. Hundreds of witchcraft ads are published in newspapers, and the Internet is full of websites of hereditary shamans and fortune tellers. But how does the magic industry actually work, where quite real, and at the same time, considerable money is involved? We will show the whole truth about otherworldly trade! The famous mentalist Lior Suchard and a psychologist-reporter with 15 years of experience Angela Boskis will reveal the secrets of a profitable business. How much does a miracle cost in modern packaging? What is the basis - the desire to help or the thirst for profit? How to distinguish a real psychic from a skilled charlatan? And do shamans have quality certificates? Lior Suchard and Angela Boskis will find real, practicing magicians and test their skills in practice. No tricks or special effects! To believe or not to believe is up to you.
title: Сверхъестественные

overview: Robin Hood is described as a sweeping, romantic adventure, a modern take of the classic tale that brings historical authenticity, psychological depth, and a heightened focus on the relationship between Rob and Marian. In the series, following the Norman invasion of England, Rob – a Saxon forester's son – and Marian, the daughter of a Norman lord – fall in love and work together to fight for justice and freedom. As Rob rises as the leader of a band of rebel outlaws, Marian infiltrates the power at court, as both work together to thwart royal corruption and bring peace to the land.
title: Robin Hood

overview: The Successor (also known as The Next Uri Geller) is an Israeli television competition program in which contestants perform acts of mentalism, illusion, escapism and other feats before a live studio audience. The acts are judged by a panel, with votes from the studio audience and viewers at home. The original program was created by Uri Geller in 2006 for Israeli television, with Geller also acting as one of the judges on the show.
title: The Successor

overview: There is a new spectacular show on the Russia TV channel! 10 participants of the project, each of whom is endowed with incredible paranormal abilities, will take part in the tests for the title of the best! All of them passed a difficult casting and are now ready to surprise everyone with their unique abilities and show real miracles! Uri Geller is the main character of the program. This is a man with truly outstanding strength: he easily bends steel spoons without touching them, and can fix broken appliances in any home from the TV screen. Invited stars will take part in amazing experiments, who, along with all the other guests of the studio, will become witnesses of incredible, inexplicable events.
title: Феномен

overview: A show where interesting people discuss interesting facts.
title: Факты

overview: At Cheng Yan's advancement ceremony, her martial brother Cheng Tian forced her into dual cultivation. In despair, Cheng Yan self-destructed her inner core but was saved by her contracted magical beast, Chen. She later discovered that Cheng Tian's body had been taken over by the ancient magical beast, Sha. Determined to avenge herself, she began her quest for revenge. Cheng Yan refined an ancient artifact to restore her inner core but was poisoned in the process, leaving her with little time to live. She chose to marry Chen but sent him back to the demon realm the day after their wedding and was killed shortly after. Enraged, Chen returned to Longqiu only to find that Cheng Yan had been reborn as Lu Ming, an immortal. Using Lu Ming's identity, Cheng Yan attempted to reseal Sha but was exposed. She and Chen ultimately joined forces in a final battle, sealing Sha for good and restoring peace to the three realms.
title: The Seized Destiny

overview: Throughout history, we've been haunted by the owl's screech, the enigmatic world of bats, the hidden realm of snakes, and the sinister reputation of toads and witches. While some might argue these fears are antiquated, the opposite holds true. Centuries of superstitions have etched these anxieties into our very genes, resulting in animals becoming unjust targets through hunting, extermination, or labeling them as pests.
title: Beasts & Witches

overview: Million Dollar Zombie Flips follows James Dainard and his team as they hunt for, fix, and flip zombie houses in the Seattle area. In each episode, James brings the cash and teams up with a rookie flipper who finds a dilapidated house and together, they attempt to turn it into a stunning million-dollar home. Following James' plan, the flipping partner is in charge of the renovation process and if all goes smoothly, they split the profit 50/50. However, if the newbie can't meet the team's standards, James will take over and keep the full profit for himself. With millions of dollars on the line, do these real-estate newbies have what it takes to turn big bucks in the high-stakes world of flipping?
title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips

overview: Sin City Gigolo: A Murder in Las Vegas which follows the criminal investigation of a former GIGOLOS cast member who was arrested for killing a young female client.
title: Sin City Gigolo: A Murder in Las Vegas

overview: Single Black Female follows Monica, who's reeling from the death of her beloved father and a difficult breakup, ready to move forward with her life as she tries to land the new hosting job for an afternoon talk show. When the station hires her a new assistant, Simone, the two quickly become close friends as Simone moves in next door and completely immerses herself in Monica's life. But underneath her sweet exterior, Simone harbours a dark secret and as time goes on cracks in her façade begin to appear. Monica decides to sever ties once and for all with Simone, but Simone has other plans and is determined to take over Monica's life for good.
title: Single Black Female

overview: Special news coverage from the CTV News team.
title: CTV News Special

overview: CBC today announced that veteran broadcaster and award-winning journalist Ian Hanomansing will host a new CBC News daily primetime program rooted in Western Canada, HANOMANSING TONIGHT, live from CBC Vancouver beginning Tuesday, February 18. Offering breaking and live news coverage with the professionalism and personality that he is known for.
title: Hanomansing Tonight

overview: Set against a ticking clock, this two-part Sky History commission tells an urgent story of political drama, military bravery, and loss in a defining moment in the history of modern Russia. Kursk: 10 Days That Shaped Putin is a dramatic and forensic examination of events that took place in August 2000, after an explosion onboard the Kursk submarine trapped a group of survivors at the bottom of the Barents Sea. Why did the Russians take so long to accept international assistance? How did this crisis and subsequent reporting change Russia and importantly, how would it shape Putin's own trajectory as the new President of Russia? The film hears first-hand testimony from those involved from President Bill Clinton to families of the submariners and an American submarine Commander who witnessed it first hand, taking us behind the closed doors of the White House, and below the surface with rescue divers who finally make it down to the stricken submarine.
title: Kursk: 10 Days that Shaped Putin

overview: After wrapping the final Twilight film, Taylor Lautner vanished from the spotlight. Fans speculated, tabloids theorized—but the truth is wilder than fiction. Taylor wasn't just taking a mental health break. He was preparing for his real calling... Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter. Playing himself, Taylor is drawn into a secret society of werewolf trackers who need his unique expertise. As he navigates his double life—Hollywood actor by day, supernatural warrior by night—Taylor must wrestle with the ultimate irony: fighting the very creatures that made him famous. Between saving the world, reviving his career, and falling in love, he faces the ultimate question—what happens when your biggest role becomes your greatest enemy?
title: Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter

overview: We meet the magnetic Emma Harte in 1911, as an impoverished, ambitious maid in Yorkshire, England, and follow her irresistible and dizzying climb to become the world's richest woman, gazing down on her sprawling empire from a luxury New York penthouse. The background to Emma Harte's rags-to-riches rise is the tale of women through the 20th century, as Emma defies the expectations of her society, fearlessly challenging the roles she's given, smashing glass ceilings, and never, ever deviating from her masterplan: Get to the top. Whatever it takes. A housemaid-turned-mogul, daughter, mother, lover, fighter and a 20th century feminist icon who refused to know her ‘place', Emma Harte returns to Channel 4 once again to delight and scandalise audiences.
title: A Woman of Substance

overview: West London duty solicitor Pierre is a force of nature: charming and funny, a glamorous character in an unglamorous profession, juggling the pressures of his job, a fragile personal life and just keeping his head above water financially. His resilience is tested when he begins investigating the suspicious death of a young black client, Michael. As Pierre challenges the police's portrayal of Michael as a criminal, he unravels a chilling web of institutional corruption… When you come at the system, the system comes at you…
title: Pierre

overview: Leaving their lives in London behind, Anna and her teenage daughter Maya must take on new identities and relocate to a small rural town. As they try to adjust to their new reality, the trauma of their past continues to haunt them and the sinister presence of two hitmen leaves a trail of unease as they search for the missing mother and daughter. As the walls close in on them it becomes clear that the dangerous figure from their past is still a looming threat.
title: Maya

overview: Follow a trail of secrets so dark and twisted that keeping them hidden becomes more than an obsession; it's a motive for murder. Delve into the shocking true stories behind tragic deaths no one, least of all the victims, could have seen coming.
title: A Secret to Die For

overview: The Rachel Incident is aching with unrequited love, shot through with delicious, sparkling humour about friends, lovers, Ireland in chaos, and a young woman desperately trying to manage all three… Rachel is a student working at a bookstore when she meets James, and it is love at first sight. Effervescent and insistently heterosexual, James soon invites Rachel to be his roommate, and the two begin a friendship that changes the course of both their lives forever. Together, they run riot through the streets of Cork City, trying to maintain a bohemian existence while the threat of the financial crash looms before them. When Rachel falls in love with her married professor, Dr Fred Byrne, James helps her devise a reading at their local bookstore, with the goal that she might seduce him afterwards. But Fred has other desires. So begins a series of secrets and compromises that intertwine the fates of James, Rachel, Fred, and Fred's glamorous, well-connected wife Deenie.
title: The Rachel Incident

overview: Anna is a devoted nun who has spent most of her adult life in a convent whilst David, a catholic priest, is at the top of his game, committed to his work in the church and the Bristol community that surrounds it. Neither are expected to fall in love… However, when they do, both Anna and David are forced to wrestle with what it means for them, their vows, and their relationship with God.
title: Falling

overview: A documentary blockbuster about the structure of elite European football through portraits of the strongest Russian players
title: Западная трибуна

overview: When the "family diamond machine " disappeared like a puzzle Causing one family to face serious allegations that it is "the thief " the only way to recover dignity and find the truth Is to reveal the mystery of "the Wakefield House " that is full of secrets and clues waiting to solve the mystery.
title: Krong Karawek

overview: Kongkai lives his life as a playboy, so his mother wants him to get married with a girl who can make him better. So, she forces him to marry with Arunprapai, a good girl she finds for him. Arunprapai accepts to marry with a guy who she doesn't love to avoid the rumor that she commits adultery with Phuchong, her ex-boyfriend who is going to have a baby with another girl by accident. However, Kongkai and Arunprapai's marriage life is not smooth because Kongkai also has girlfriend named Prungchat and she wants to get him back.
title: Mia Taeng

overview: On the eve of graduation, students are locked in the music room and told they must kill each other to survive. A music teacher, seeking revenge for the death of his fiancée, transforms into a "mad teacher."
title: Saigo no Jugyou -Ikinokotta Mono Dake ga Sotsugyou-

overview: Paula, 40, is nearing the end of her maternity leave. She has to return to work in a few days. But she's not ready. Orso, her youngest, has exhausted her, not to mention her two older children. With her husband Jérôme, she recruits Tess, an au pair... Tess seems perfect. She's a rare gem. But Paula quickly feels uncomfortable with the young girl. Yet she's the only one. Everyone adores Tess... But she notices changes in her home and the increasing number of incidents that make her seem like a bad mother... She senses something is wrong, but no one believes her when she says Tess wants to harm them... She's told it's probably her baby blues that's making her paranoid. Or does Paula herself have things to hide? As for Tess, she didn't end up there by chance. What is she looking for when she enters this home? When a stranger invades your privacy, you have to weigh the risks and consequences. A family is often tiring and exhausting, yet it's when you risk losing it that you realise its full importance.
title: L'intruse

overview: Lieberman, a famous Nazi hunter, is drawn to investigate a conspiracy spun to him by a young Nazi hunter. Lieberman is highly skeptical of the young man's claims that notorious Dr. Josef Mengele is in Paraguay, starting on a diabolical plan to reestablish the Third Reich through a cloning plan put in place after Germany lost World War II. When the young Nazi hunter is killed, Lieberman heads to Paraguay to uncover a truth that turns out to be horrific.
title: The Boys from Brazil

overview: 1800 year. Europe is on the eve of big changes. Napoleon Bonaparte is preparing for great deeds, but family "battles" interfere with this.
title: Адъютанты любви

overview: Gu Man Qing couldn't stand her husband Shen Jun's long-term domestic violence, so she faked her death to escape. Later, she met the plastic surgeon Wen Yi Huai and begged him to change her face. Wen Yi Huai agreed and asked Gu Man Qing to pretend to be his deceased wife. Unexpectedly, Shen Jun found out, and the three of them started a thrilling game of chase and escape.
title: Don't Leave Me

overview: The love story of an ascetic director and a poor student
title: Xu Ni Yi Chang Bei Huan

overview: He Yan, the president of Fanxing Group, was in a car accident on the anniversary of her father's death. After being disfigured, her fiancé Yu Ge seized power. She asked Lin Xiao, who looked similar to her, to pretend to be her, trying to find evidence of Yu Ge's guilt. In the process, Yu Ge developed feelings for Lin Xiao, and Lin Xiao gradually wavered in their relationship. As the truth was revealed, He Yan's revenge plan, Yu Ge's life secrets, and Lin Xiao's life secrets intertwined, triggering a series of emotional entanglements and fierce conflicts.
title: World Upside Down

overview: After her boyfriend cheats, a girl proposes a fictitious marriage to her childhood friend to participate in a talk show about love
title: Women who act coquettishly have the best luck

overview: Jewelry designer Xie Qing Han was trapped by Qiao Yi Zhou's false "favor" trap. She constantly compromised for love, stayed away from society, and lost herself, becoming a "gunman" used by her boyfriend Qiao Yi Zhou. But after meeting Shao Qing Yun, Xie Qing Han gradually realized that her cognition had always been narrow and wrong. Normal feelings should be mutual understanding and mutual achievement, rather than gaining pleasure and achievements by oppressing each other. Under Shao Qing Yun's strong intervention, Xie Qing Han kept growing. She re-engaged with society, resumed work, and restarted her beloved career.
title: Stealing Beauty

overview: 1913. The whole world is on the brink of the abyss, but there are havens of peace isolated from the conflicts. Like the La Promesa Palace, in the valley of Los Pedroches, property of the Marquises of Luján, one of the largest landowners in the country. Can love quench the thirst for revenge? Could you forget those who ruined your life? The murderers of your mother? Those who made your brother disappear? A woman, revenge and a great love story are the ingredients of La Promesa.
title: La Promesa

overview: The Comeback Kid. Baby J. Andrew Glouberman. John Mulaney has many names in the Netflix universe, and he's about to claim one more: live variety talk show host.
title: Everybody's Live with John Mulaney

overview: In the ruggedness of the American West, death is always a shadow over the shoulder: a grizzly bear encounter, an avalanche, or a bite from a rattlesnake can change everything in an instant; and those are just the natural threats; if one wants to get away with murder, the mountain ranges of the West may be the perfect place to do it; peering into the dusty files found in the back country sheriff's offices and highlighting the cases that were deemed unsolvable because the crime scene was too rugged, too remote, or the victim assumed too hard to find; despite the odds in this landscape, justice prevails.
title: Cold Case Files: Dead West

overview: Stadium game day in Cleveland, Ohio, is an electric, cathartic, emotional experience shared by 67,000 die-hard fans coming together inside this city within a city. Protecting them is a highly trained force of nearly 1,000 brave and dedicated men and women from law enforcement, multiple private security agencies and medics from the nearby hospital. This new series provides unprecedented access to the stadium's command center where more than 500 CCTV cameras are monitored in real time. Whether it's large-scale brawls, lifesaving resuscitations, or heartfelt reunions with missing children — viewers get a behind-the-scenes look, as officers and medics are dispatched on hundreds of calls including instances of fans breaking the strict code of conduct, resulting in ejection or worse — a one-way ticket to Stadium Lockup.
title: Stadium Lockup

overview: Yes, Chef! blends the high-stakes thrill of a cooking competition with the raw emotion of personal transformation as it delves into the powerful personalities attracted to the chaotic culinary lifestyle. The series puts 12 highly skilled chefs, who have been nominated by their bosses, co-workers, friends and even family, through the ultimate test. These rising stars all have natural talent, but their egos, intensity, stubbornness or short fuses are holding them back from reaching their full potential. The chefs will have to prove they have the culinary chops and the right attitude to make it to the end. The chef who handles the heat, impressing with both their food and teamwork while improving their behavior, will take home the $250,000 grand prize, provided by granola brand Purely Elizabeth.
title: Yes, Chef!

overview: Detectives in major cities in the United States race against the clock in the wake of homicides, knowing that if they don't find a lead within the first 48 hours, their chances of solving a case are cut in half. The programme shows how detectives use forensic evidence and witness interviews to help identify suspects.
title: First 48: Wrong Place, Wrong Time

overview: Bewitched is an American fantasy sitcom television series about a witch (Samantha) who marries an ordinary mortal man (Darrin) and vows to lead the life of a typical suburban housewife. Although they agree that Sam is not to use witchcraft now that they are married, a problem always seems to crop up and Sam always resorts to spells. Things become even more complicated when Endora, Samantha's witch mother, starts to interfere.
title: Bewitched

overview: Force of Nature is a groundbreaking series filmed over three years, revealing how nature is fighting back against today's extreme weather. Witness the scale and ferocity of nature's most powerful forces - from hurricanes and flash floods to droughts and bushfires - and discover the ingenious ways nature endures, adapts and prevails against these new extremes. Through the eyes of heroic animal characters, this heartfelt, dramatic and inspiring series shows how the natural world is rising to the challenge. There has never been a more pressing and relevant natural history series.
title: Force of Nature

overview: Special news coverage from the Network Ten team.
title: 10 News First Special

overview: Accused: Did I Do It? follows the high-stakes stories of individuals who stood trial and are facing charges for serious offenses such as first-degree murder, manslaughter, domestic terrorism and aggravated assault. Every piece of evidence may lead to an answer, but the truth is never quite clear until the final moment of reveal. Intimately filmed in prisons and homes across the US, the location of the accused is kept a mystery as the story unfolds. Key turning points, evidence, and decisions that led to charges and eventual verdicts are pieced together with nail-biting testimony, explosive trial footage, and interviews with their defense attorneys and family members.
title: Accused: Did I Do It?

overview: Wrapping up the night with post-game interviews and analysis.
title: Hockey Night in Canada on CBC: After Hours

overview: Tense thriller from Russell T Davies, with Alan Cumming and David Morrissey. An ordinary Manchester suburb becomes a minefield of lies and violence when Leo gives neighbour Clive his spare key.
title: Tip Toe

overview: Twelve strangers arrive at a grand English country estate, lured by one irresistible opportunity: to inherit a chunk of a vast fortune. The fortune belonged to a glamorous benefactor known only as The Deceased who has left video messages for the players from beyond the grave. To release money from The Inheritance, players must work as a team to complete a series of challenges. The better they perform; the more money is released. But The Deceased had a wicked sense of humour and one ruthless condition: to win the game they must persuade all others that only they should be entrusted with the money. It's a game of wit, willpower, persuasion, and betrayal, where it's not about who deserves the money, but who's willing to outplay, out-charm, and out-scheme the competition to claim it.
title: The Inheritance

overview: The Hunt - a heart-pounding, high-stakes game of predator versus prey, where there is only one rule – hunt or be hunted. Deep in a vast unforgiving forest, contestants are dropped into the ultimate real-world game of hide and seek - where losing means walking away with nothing and winning could mean pocketing up to £100,000. Surviving the game isn't about being the fastest. It's about being the smartest.
title: The Hunt

overview: All Fours, Miranda July's propulsive, sexy and irreverent novel about a woman at a turning point in her life who embarks on a journey of self-discovery and sexual awakening.
title: All Fours

overview: Focusing on real-life cases in New Zealand, forensic science is combined with clever investigation techniques to unlock what really happened in criminal mysteries.
title: Forensics NZ

overview: Dhruv and Amrita, potential marriage partners, decided to live together before the wedding to test their compatibility. As they spend time together, the question arises that whether they develop romantic feelings between them.
title: Pyaar Testing

overview: Ye Meng's journey to the north ended and then she returned to her hometown to get married. Who would have expected that on the wedding night, Ye Meng would go back to the north. The man sent her ten messages in a row while holding a bachelor party at home. Ye Meng completely ignored him, blocked him, letting him cause whatever troubles he wanted. To force Ye Meng to return to Y City, this young man used all kinds of tricks, including divorce papers, notices of terminal illness, etc. However, Ye Meng remained totally unmoved and kept prospering in Beijing.
title: Deep Affection Eyes

overview: High school drama following diverse teenagers as they join a support group after a student's tragic loss. Despite differing values, they find self-discovery and shared passion for life and love through their confessions.
title: Física o Química: La nueva generación

overview: Microphone and camera on KHL referees. Showing the best European hockey from the first person
title: Хороший гол

overview: A quiz competition for the quick-witted. The panel has 20 questions to find the solution to the task!
title: 20 spørsmål

overview: Viewers will be treated to this weekly live showcase of the league's top teams and star players, and fans can expect thrilling matchups, innovative camera angles, and insightful commentary from industry experts.
title: Arena Football One

overview: Jackie Price has been living a luxurious existence for the last twenty years – travelling the world, selling fine art using sophisticated tax loopholes, and, above all, trying to stay anonymous after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life starts to feel a little boring, it takes a sudden lethal turn when she discovers The Seven Demons, a squad of the world's most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her. Assuming someone from her past is behind it, Jackie unleashes her old instincts and embarks on a wild, dangerous game plan: to take down The Demons one by one before they kill her. However, she soon realises her own demons are much more terrifying than the ruthless killers on her trail... and her buried secrets ultimately lead her much closer to home, with surprising consequences.
title: Kill Jackie

overview: To avenge his parents, Lu Yan gradually advanced his plan. But Mu Lan kept sabotaging it. Upon deeper investigation, Lu Yan discovered that she was the girl he had a crush on in childhood. From being adversaries to allying, they targeted the fake "Lu Changhe." But "Lu Changhe" had already seen through all their moves...
title: Accidental Firing

overview: An innovative talk show that offers a multifaceted and revealing perspective on current affairs, highlighting the female angle with five participants from different generations, styles, nationalities, and cultures. Desiguales is known for its diverse approach, with lively discussions on current topics, entertainment news, and personal stories from the hosts and their guests. With its relaxed and energetic style, the show has become a favorite of viewers seeking an entertaining and light experience. Additionally, it has been praised for its close connection with its audience, thanks to the blend of humor, personality, and current pop culture topics.
title: Desiguales

overview: Bravo's Love Hotel brings together some of "The Real Housewives" franchise fan favorites for the ultimate luxurious getaway in the hopes of finding true love. The ladies will head to the Grand Velas Boutique Hotel in Los Cabos, Mexico, where they will mix and mingle with a group of eligible bachelors, each vying for the chance to win their hearts and put the "wives" back in "Housewives."
title: Bravo's Love Hotel

overview: Twitter: Breaking the Bird features new interviews with co-founder and former CEO Ev Williams and co-founder Biz Stone, who share their personal experiences of how a group of idealistic friends set out to build a digital utopia, and how that vision morphed into the platform now owned by Elon Musk. Featuring additional insight from numerous Twitter employees from the rank and file to the C-suite, and analysis from journalists like Kara Swisher who have been covering the company since day one, Twitter: Breaking the Bird is the definitive tale of the corporate clashes, revolving door leadership and tech bro hubris hidden behind the scenes at this once-trailblazing company.
title: Twitter: Breaking the Bird

overview: The Klyachev family lives in the picturesque town of the Golden Ring: writer Anton Pavlovich, his son Leonid, a blacksmith, and grandson Prometheus, who works as a lifeguard. The Larin family lives in the same city: taxi driver Valentina Petrovna, her daughter is a tour guide Sveta, and her granddaughter is an artist Julia. Prometheus is convinced that Julia is a fraud. He uncovers one of her scams and turns her over to the police. Their meeting becomes fateful not only for the characters themselves, but also for their relatives, who no longer hoped for personal happiness.
title: Три плюс три

overview: The 1960s. Soviet intelligence learns about US plans to strike from military bases located in Germany. Brezhnev understands that a retaliatory ultimatum will be the beginning of a nuclear catastrophe, so he decides to take the risk of concluding a secret agreement with German Chancellor Willy Brandt. To do this, he recruits former front-line soldier Vyacheslav Vardanov and German journalist Valery Pletnev. Together, they will complete an unprecedented mission, on the success of which the fate of the entire world depends.
title: Дорогой Вилли

overview: Ksenia, a famous figure skater in the past, returns to her hometown to uncover the mystery of the death of her figure skating partner Alexei, which occurred 10 years ago. She gets a job as a coach at her former sports school and soon realizes that nothing has changed here: intrigues are still being wove, hidden games are being played, and in every family where young figure skaters grow up, their skeletons are hidden in the closet. The children face the same problems as Ksenia once did, and the girl realizes that all this can lead to a terrible tragedy again. In addition, the head coach of the school is still the domineering Alevtina, who knows exactly how Alexey died...
title: На льду

overview: There is a little-known medical fact: a woman can give birth to twins from different men. Lada finds itself in just such a situation. A guy leaves a girl on the anniversary of a relationship right in bed. Together with her friend, the heroine goes to drink down her grief at the club. There, she very conveniently meets an old acquaintance who is ready to heal her mental wound. After a while, Lada finds out that she is pregnant. Now the future mother of two little angels needs to find out who their father is. Or the fathers…
title: Интересное положение

overview: Marilú is a secretary who inherits a percentage of Funerales Garza Gallardo from her boss, Don Anselmo. This percentage makes her the partner of Matías: Don Anselmo's son and heir, who is prevented from selling the business by his new partner.
title: Muero por Marilú

overview: In this Emmy Award-winning dramatization of historical events, Peter O'Toole stars as the Roman general tasked with crushing a group of Jewish rebels who have sought refuge on Masada, a desert fortress, in A.D. 72. Despite superior numbers and supplies, the Romans find themselves endlessly frustrated in their attempts to thwart the rebels' last stand. The star-studded cast also includes Peter Strauss, Barbara Carrera and Anthony Quayle.
title: Masada

overview: July 2014. When Malaysian Airlines flight MH17 crashes in Ukraine, killing all 298 people on board, the circumstances are shrouded in mystery. With a regional war beginning to rage around the crash site, disinformation is everywhere. Western governments are left scrabbling for detail while one civilian is leading the hunt for answers – Dad of two and amateur blogger Eliot Higgins. And with an unlikely team of online detectives by his side, he's ready to fight all the way to the truth. Combining the geopolitical stakes of NAVALNY and LOCKERBIE with the pulsating internet sleuthing of DON'T F*** WITH CATS, this gripping documentary series follows the 21st Century's most politically significant plane crash - an international David vs. Goliath narrative following a bunch of unexpected heroes who risked their lives to fight for justice.
title: Murder in the Skies: Who Downed MH17?

overview: Georgia Harrison dives into the secretive world of online porn to find out how this industry works and how non-consensual pornographic images are being created and used to help drive profits and power to individuals. The world of online porn is not easy to escape, so how does it make money and who are the people profiting from a kind of footage where little accountability is involved?
title: Georgia Harrison: Porn, Power, Profit

overview: Su Xiao Zhao, a commoner-born but exceptionally talented cook, accidentally wandered into a hunting ground while gathering ingredients. By chance, she saved Third Young Master Zhao Han, who was targeted by assassins, and thus became entangled in the undercurrents of the struggle for the city lord's position...
title: My Unpredictable Lover

overview: Matilde Kimer investigates how Denmark conducted espionage during the Cold War. For the first time, FE has allowed former employees to break their lifelong silence and tell the story from the inside.
title: Danske spioner i den kolde krig
Требуется мама в семью с тремя детьми

overview: Mini-series continuing the story of "Mr. Hiiragi's Homeroom". It shows events regarding a special graduation ceremony only for the students of Hiiragi-sensei.
title: 3-nen A-gumi: Ima kara Minasan Dake no, Sotsugyoshiki Desu

overview: All Star Family Fortunes is a British television game show broadcast on ITV and presented by Vernon Kay which began airing on 28 October 2006. It is a celebrity revival of the original Family Fortunes that aired from 6 January 1980 until 6 December 2002, based on the American game show Family Feud.
title: All Star Family Fortunes

overview: Good Day is a music project where G-Dragon collaborates with people from various fields to create the song of the year. As the producer, G-Dragon will take the lead in crafting music, turning different individuals' stories into songs, all while showcasing the creative process through a reality variety format. Confirmed guests include top actors Hwang Jung-min and Kim Go-eun, who joined the show after resonating with its concept. Additionally, the famous "88-line" stars—Kim Soo-hyun, Jung Hae-in, Im Si-wan, Kwanghee, and Lee Soo-hyuk—are set to appear, heightening anticipation. Other big names include SEVENTEEN's unit BSS (Seungkwan, DK, Hoshi), TV personalities Hong Jin-kyung and Kian84, as well as celebrity chef Ahn Sung-jae, all adding to the excitement for the show's premiere.
title: Good Day

overview: Mason is an expert on queer relationships and a matchmaker with a booming success rate. When it comes to love, he knows all...except why his own relationship is on the rocks.
title: Settle Down

overview: The drama portrays the decade long relationship between a student and his teacher.
title: Caged Bird

overview: When he gets tangled up with a mafia boss's son's girlfriend and ends up in a scuffle, young Yothin needs to find a safe place. Instead of sending him overseas, his father decides to send him to the countryside! There, he stays in Bang Pho under the care of subdistrict headman, a close friend of his father. He's also under the watchful eye of the village headman who happens to be the subdistrict headman's grandson and is overseeing his probation. As Yothin spends more time with Jomkhwan, his perception of the village headman begins gradually to change.
title: My Sweetheart Jom

overview: To pay off her debts, she signed an agreement with him to become his mistress. How long will it take? Maybe forever
title: Bird in the hands of a paranoid

overview: This unique series narrated by Sir Tony Robinson uses home movie archive to reveal life in 20th Century Britain as never seen before. From the Blitz to the Beatles, the last days of steam trains and working canal boats to royal coronations, these filmmakers captured everything. Each episode is devoted to the decades of the Thirties, World War Two, The Fifties and ending with the roaring Sixties.
title: Britain on Film with Tony Robinson

overview: Jiang Xiaoning is a young girl obsessed with studying. At 21, she has already acquired many diplomas, but she doesn't even think about marriage. Qi Yinli is the heir to the Qi family, dedicated to his career as a doctor, completely indifferent to the opposite sex. Their parents secretly marry them in the hope that the young people will fall in love with each other. But they don't even want to get acquainted, they only want a divorce. But fate has already taken a strong hold of them.
title: Doctor Qi, your confused baby is crying again

overview: In the year 1422, a series of murders throws the city of Tallinn into turmoil. When the corpse of a knight of the order is desecrated, the young apothecary Melchior Wakenstede, who according to rumour can communicate with the dead, takes over the investigation.
title: Apteeker Melchior
